nodes.title: SG-11.2.2 Store and release the transitionTo unsubscribe in BootScene
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene.create subscribes to the transitionTo event through reactToPhaser.on and already keeps the returned function in the private field unsubscribeTransition. The SHUTDOWN handler already calls and nulls it. Desired behavior: the stored unsubscribe is called and cleared on SHUTDOWN, so a restarted scene does not hold duplicate transitionTo handlers. Expected result: exactly one fade-out per transitionTo event after any number of scene restarts. Why: a duplicate handler would fade and start the scene several times.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given BootScene.create has run, when transitionTo is emitted, then exactly one fadeOut call is made
- Given the SHUTDOWN callback has run, when transitionTo is emitted, then no fadeOut and no scene.start happens
- Given the scene was shut down and created again, when transitionTo is emitted, then fadeOut is called exactly once


## Scope
- In scope: unsubscribeTransition field and SHUTDOWN handler in BootScene
- Out of scope: playAnimation and store subscription handling
- Out of scope: new events
- Preserve: fade-out then scene.start behavior of transitionTo
- Preserve: other subscribers on reactToPhaser


## Technical constraints
- Phaser 3.90 APIs only
- No real Phaser or browser in tests


## Definition of done
- Both requirements have Act and Verify units complete
- Unit tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · BootScene.create stores the transitionTo unsubscribe function
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene declares unsubscribeTransition at L33 and assigns it in create at L76. Desired behavior: the handle is retained so it can be released later. Expected result: after create the field holds the unsubscribe function, and one emit produces one fade. Why: without the handle the subscription could never be released.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given create has run, when transitionTo is emitted once, then fadeOut is called exactly once with the transition duration
- Given the scene is shut down and created again, when transitionTo is emitted once, then fadeOut is called exactly once in total


## Scope
- In scope: assignment of unsubscribeTransition in BootScene.create
- Out of scope: SHUTDOWN handler changes
- Preserve: existing transitionTo fade and start logic


## Technical constraints
- Field typed (() => void) | null


## Definition of done
- Field assigned from reactToPhaser.on return value


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · BootScene SHUTDOWN calls and clears the transitionTo unsubscribe
nodes.body:
Context: the SHUTDOWN callback registered in create already calls unsubscribeTransition?.() and nulls it at L97-L98. Desired behavior: after shutdown no transitionTo event reaches BootScene, while other subscribers keep working. Expected result: no fade or scene start after shutdown. Why: avoids duplicate handlers after restart.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the SHUTDOWN callback has run, when transitionTo is emitted, then fadeOut and scene.start are not called
- Given another subscriber registered before create, when SHUTDOWN has run and transitionTo is emitted, then that subscriber still receives the payload


## Scope
- In scope: transitionTo release in the SHUTDOWN handler
- Out of scope: other unsubscribe fields
- Preserve: order and behavior of the other cleanup calls


## Technical constraints
- Release must happen inside the existing SHUTDOWN handler


## Definition of done
- unsubscribeTransition is called and set to null in SHUTDOWN


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.summary: Unit tests for single fade after create and after restart
nodes.description: Add tests with Phaser mocked, copying the vi.mock setup from tests/bootSceneTransition.test.ts (camera with fadeOut and once spies, scene.start spy).
acceptance_criteria: One emit after create gives one fadeOut
One emit after shutdown plus re-create gives one fadeOut on the new scene

steps.action: Create the file reusing the phaser and content vi.mock blocks from bootSceneTransition.test.ts; in beforeEach call reactToPhaser.clear(), set useGameStore state with createInitialState, then new BootScene().create()
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneTransitionStore.test.ts

steps.symbol: it('fades out exactly once per transitionTo after create')
steps.action: Emit reactToPhaser.emit('transitionTo', { sceneId: 'library' }) once and assert boot.cameras.main.fadeOut toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneTransitionStore.test.ts -t 'exactly once per transitionTo'

steps.symbol: it('fades out once on the new scene after shutdown and re-create')
steps.action: Run the SHUTDOWN callback found in boot.events.once.mock.calls (name 'shutdown'), create a second BootScene and call create(), emit transitionTo { sceneId: 'library' } once, assert the second scene's fadeOut was called once and the first scene's fadeOut was not called again
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneTransitionStore.test.ts -t 're-create'
